about_the_game:
Step into the opening moments of Proxima Divide, a first-person sci-fi survival game set on a distant alien world. In this demo, you'll experience the first 20 minutes of gameplay—awakening alone after a crash landing, scavenging for resources, and exploring a silent research outpost with dwindling oxygen and no sign of life.

Uncover early clues, repair broken systems, and confront the first signs of danger as you begin to piece together what happened to the colonists. This short slice offers a glimpse into the immersive survival mechanics, atmospheric world design, and narrative-driven exploration that define the full game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or equivalent with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended

short_description: A first-person sci-fi survival demo where you scavenge for resources, manage oxygen, and explore the opening of a mysterious alien outpost after a crash landing.
